description: This source file defines a custom JSP tag class 'AdminProductDownloadUrlTag' used to generate download URLs for digital products within an admin interface of a web application. It constructs a URL based on store configuration and product information.

classes.name: AdminProductDownloadUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag extending TagSupport that constructs a download URL for a digital product based on store and request configurations.

methods.name: getDigitalProduct
methods.description: Accessor for the DigitalProduct associated with this tag.

methods.name: setDigitalProduct
methods.description: Mutator to assign a DigitalProduct to this tag.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the download URL for the digital product and writes it to the page output.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the tag processing, continuing page rendering.
